rationale: Roberts is best positioned to assign and keep a unanimous, institutionally modest vacate-and-remand opinion centered on Bruen’s limiting principle (no “Manhattan-as-sensitive-place” aggregation) and Rule 702 boundaries for historical experts. Thomas/Kavanaugh (and possibly Alito or Gorsuch) are the most likely to write separately to press a clearer merits holding and tighter guidance on sensitive places and the State’s historical-burden showing.
